children: ArcelorMittal SA ADR (EURONEXT:MT) reported Q3 EBITDA rose 34% to $2.02 billion, beating estimates, while revenue gained 5% to $16.47 billion. It reported a $391 million loss, including impairment and Ukraine-related charges.
: ArcelorMittal’s Q3 EBITDA rose 34% to $2.02 billion, beating estimates, while revenue gained 5% to $16.47 billion. It reported a $391 million loss, including impairment and Ukraine-related charges.
: ArcelorMittal said its Gijón and Sestao electric-arc furnaces remain on track for commissioning in late 2026, with ramp-up through 2027. Its Dunkirk furnace project has entered execution.
: ArcelorMittal expects to fully benefit from Europe’s new tariff-rate quota framework in 2027, as higher prices flow through orders and automotive flat-product contracts face repricing.
: ArcelorMittal said all European blast furnaces are operating again, while stronger EU trade measures are beginning to rebalance the steel market. The company expects their full impact next year.
: ArcelorMittal (MT) shipped 10.5 million tons from its Liberia mine in the first nine months and aims for 16 million this year. It expects full capacity in Q4 and 20 million tons in 2027.
: ArcelorMittal (MT) will pay a €0.15 quarterly dividend on Dec. 2. Shares trade ex-dividend Nov. 12; investors must buy by Nov. 11 to qualify.
: Magallanes Value Investors partially reduced its exposure to ArcelorMittal SA ADR (MT), realizing substantial gains.
